description: x402-perp-funding-radar: Cross-venue funding radar: the same perpetual's funding on Hyperliquid, dYdX, Bybit and Binance, normalised to one hourly basis and annualised, with mark price and open interest side by side, plus the cheapest venue to be long and the richest to be short. Params: asset (base symbol, e.g. BTC), limit (1-200 rows, default 25), minAnnualSpreadPct (filter), historyDays (0-30 adds a history block), alertAnnualPct (flag rows above this annualised %).
name: x402-perp-funding-radar
